verdict.rationale: The evidence shows llamafile runs models entirely on-device and offline, with no cloud and no data sharing. That is an adjacent privacy property, not a documented retention or deletion control. Nothing describes settings for conversation or log retention, history deletion, or purge behaviour. Any deletion would rely on the user managing local files, which is a host-platform workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
